OBFUSCATED_FISH_3_BRONZE }} '''Trophy Fish''' are a series of [[Trophies]] that can be caught on the [[Crimson Isle]]. They come in four tiers, {{DarkGray|Bronze}}, {{Gray|Silver}}, {{Gold|Gold}}, and {{Aqua|Diamond}}, and can be filleted by {{NPCSprite|Odger}} for {{Item|Magmafish}}. Collecting each quality of each variant of '''Trophy Fish''' grants rewards. {{Stat|Trophy Chance}} increases the chance to catch '''Trophy Fish'''. == Obtaining == '''Trophy Fish''' can be occasionally caught while fishing on the [[Crimson Isle]], with different requirements to catch each '''Trophy Fish'''. There are four tiers of each '''Trophy Fish''': {{DarkGray|Bronze}}, {{Gray|Silver}}, {{Gold|Gold}}, and {{Aqua|Diamond}}. The {{Stat|Trophy Chance}} [[Stat]] can be used to increase the chance of '''Trophy Fish''' being fished up. The {{AN|Midas Lure}} perk from {{NPCSprite|Marigold}} and {{AN|Radiant Fisher}} perk from {{NPCSprite|Gemma}} only apply to {{Gold|Gold}} and {{Aqua|Diamond}} [[Trophies]] respectively. When the player catches something while [[Fishing]], all '''Trophy Fish''' that have their requirements met for are rolled as possible catches, starting from the lowest to highest catch chance.{{Confirm}} If no '''Trophy Fishes''' are caught, normal [[Fishing]] loot is rolled. In case the player has not caught a {{Gold|Gold}} and/or {{Aqua|Diamond}} tier of a '''Trophy Fish''' by then, after {{Green|100}} and {{Green|600}} catches of that '''Trophy Fish''', respectively, the next '''Trophy Fish''' caught is guaranteed to be that specific type and tier due to [[Pity]]. === Tier Chances === When a '''Trophy Fish''' is caught, the game rolls for which '''Trophy Fish''' and tier to give the player. The rarest '''Trophy Fish''' rolls first. If '''Trophy Fishes''' have the same chance, they are rolled in alphabetical order. Once the '''Trophy Fish''' is chosen, the game attempts to roll the {{Aqua|Diamond}} tier first. If the {{Aqua|Diamond}} tier is not chosen, {{Gold|Gold}} is rolled next, and so on. If the first three tiers are not granted, {{DarkGray|Bronze}} is guaranteed. The {{Ench|Charm}} [[Enchantment]] applies to each of these chances, except {{DarkGray|Bronze}}. * {{Aqua|Diamond}}: {{Green|0.2%}} ({{Green|0.224%}} with {{Ench|Charm VI}}) * {{Gold|Gold}}: {{Green|2%}} ({{Green|2.24%}} with {{Ench|Charm VI}}) * {{Gray|Silver}}: {{Green|25%}} ({{Green|28%}} with {{Ench|Charm VI}}) * {{DarkGray|Bronze}}: {{Green|100%}} Overall, the chance for each tier is as follows. Additionally, catching {{gold|Gold}} and {{aqua|Diamond}} '''Trophy Fishes''' yields {{Bits|15}} and {{Bits|30}} respectively, increased by the player's {{Bits}} multiplier. === Filleting === '''Trophy Fish''' can be filleted by {{NPCSprite|Odger}} to earn {{Item|Magmafish}}. {{:Odger/Filleting Rewards}} === SkyBlock Levels === {{Main|SkyBlock Levels}} Catching a {{DarkGray|Bronze}}, {{Gray|Silver}}, {{Gold|Gold}} and {{Aqua|Diamond}} of one type of '''Trophy Fish''' for the first time grants {{aqua|4}}, {{aqua|8}}, {{aqua|16}} and {{aqua|32}} {{SkyBlock XP}} respectively. Catching a higher tier also awards the {{SkyBlock XP}} of lower tiers. === [[Achievements]] === A '''Trophy Fish''' can be put in the furnace near the {{NPCSprite|Melancholic Viking}} to earn the {{Ach|Meal fit for a King}} [[Achievement]]. == Trivia == * The zones for [[Trophy Fishing#Moldfin|Moldfin]], [[Trophy Fishing#Volcanic Stonefish|Volcanic Stonefish]], [[Trophy Fishing#Flyfish|Flyfish]], and [[Trophy Fishing#Skeleton Fish|Skeleton Fish]] are slightly overlapped with their adjacent zones. For example, both [[Trophy Fishing#Moldfin|Moldfin]] and [[Trophy Fishing#Volcanic Stonefish|Volcanic Stonefish]] can be caught at the west edge of {{Zone|Mystic Marsh}}. == Gallery == Golden Fish
